title: FIRST FIRE UP of Our Twin Turbo 7.3L Godzilla Engine! Made AWESOME Power On The Dyno

engine.notes: oil pan + tensioner from Brian Wolf; sounds like big LS with Ford firing order; flywheel contacting bellhousing at first fire
